experiment: Predicted class and target detector box coordinates for native instance ink

protocol.hypothesis: Detector target-box relative xy plus predicted-class embedding improves strict instance ink ownership, while detector, routing, quality, decoder and merge stay frozen.
protocol.evidence: 535 development Thing FN have a same-class box; 336 have native ROI routing but no candidate reaches strict IoU>.5. Observed development only.

training.optimizer: AdamW weight_decay=.01, cosine scheduler, bf16, gradient norm1
training.initialization: Both warmstart the identical frozen round3 boundary head. Candidate adds zero-initialized class embedding and xy projection.
training.prompt: dx/width,dy/height from detector box center; per-axis extent at least1px; clip[-2,2]; pad zero; rotate and flip vector components with pixels.
training.augmentation_rng: Python/NumPy/Torch reset after model construction, explicit seeded DataLoader generators in both arms
training.checkpoint_selection: Maximum fixed 500-crop proxy, epoch0 eligible, earlier epoch retained on ties; no extension after seeing results.

evaluation.regression_only: Previously observed round2 confirmation92, round3 confirmation108, historicaltest1000; not new confirmation.
